title: Saved card belonging to another user is selectable and chargeable
summary: The payment-method lookup does not compare the record owner to the session user, so any authenticated user can select and charge a card saved by someone else.
impact: Any authenticated user can enumerate and charge other users' stored cards. Financial and personal data exposure.
recommended_action: Add an ownership check in server/payments/stripe.ts:52 before returning or using a payment method.

preconditions: User A and user B both exist
User B has a saved card
reproduction.expected: 403 Forbidden, or 404 if the design hides existence
reproduction.actual: 200 OK with user B's card brand, last4 and billing postcode
